Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 88. Category: form. Ancient Saiyan Power.

Power-Up
The ancient Saiyan draws from their reserves of
latent energy. A bestial scream erupts from them as
their ki explodes outwards.
Increase your Power by 1
Increase your Movement Speed by 10 ft.
At the end of your turn, you lose 1 Stamina
Gained at Level 3
